opening.argument: The presentation directly solicits paid participation by requiring viewers to buy educational packages and tokens, with the tokens converted into coins. It further promises that buyers before a split will duplicate their tokens, presenting purchased participation as a path to substantially larger returns. The speaker also ties recruitment to personal income, stating that package purchases by invited participants pay him a 10% commission. His example of ten friends buying 5,000 packages reinforces a downline-based solicitation rather than a neutral cryptocurrency lesson. The financial-collapse framing and claim that 5,000 euros can become 23,000 euros in roughly 90 to 120 days intensify that appeal, without establishing actual losses or outcomes.
